svg.title: The identical construction applies to P t≤n(qtDt −Ct). For simultaneous two-sided objectives split β between them. No conditional law on the future success event was used; on {τ = ∞} the stopped and actual production records agree. The fee α is paid once for the entire finite monitoring budget, not once per production use. This is standard stopped-supermartingale reasoning newly supplied for the online calibration interface. Here the proof filtration includes completed-trial scoring truths and outcomes, as in Section 7; the controller sees only the permitted accessible-record subfiltration. The admitted conditional source, ready-stock and drift promises must hold on that augmented past. Such a promise is not implied by calibration on a smaller observable history. An inert retained quantum reference does not change the label bounds; measuring that reference or a bath and feeding it back changes the conditional contract unless separately included. Physical resets and fresh source independence are not inferred.
